properties.name: ODS.DocumentType
properties.note: Meta.DocumentType may read 'Standard (Level 2)' in legacy documents

properties.name: ODS.Level
properties.note: digit only; 'Level 3' accepted and normalised by Fix

properties.name: ODS.Revision
properties.note: Meta.CoverRevision reads '01 — Approved'; legacy Meta.Revision may read '01 (approved issue)'

properties.name: ODS.ProcessOwner
properties.note: required person for PRS; otherwise 'Not applicable' preferred

properties.name: ODS.Parent
properties.note: parent document number; Level 1 may use 'Not applicable'

bookmarks.title: doc_title
bookmarks.rule: Any valid bookmark is accepted; the tag control must name the bookmark of its own heading. Fix adds <DOCID>_Hnnn where missing.

tags.scope: heading down to next heading of same or higher level; not inherited

formats.STRICT: Values in ODS.Meta content controls; tags in ODS.OMSTags@bookmark controls; heading bookmarks; 23 properties filled; Control ID controls. ONE publishes STRICT only.
formats.LITE: What writers and AI tools produce: Title and headings in template styles; tags typed as plain text in ODS Tag Line paragraphs ('OMS 6.5, 6.4'); control table as plain text; Control IDs as plain text; properties may be empty. Fix converts LITE to STRICT without changing the text.

outcomes.PASS_AFTER_FIX: all errors can be fixed automatically by ONE Fix
outcomes.FAIL: at least one error needs a person

rules.title: Document number, codes and file name
checks: system, type and site codes are valid
file name starts with the number (auto-fix: rename)

rules.title: Revision and status agree
checks: approved issues have issue and effective dates

rules.title: Custom properties
checks: all 23 present with standard names (ODS.Parent missing → warning for legacy)

rules.title: Metadata agrees in the five places
checks: control table (ODS.Meta.*) = custom properties (control table is master)

rules.title: Title bookmark and title tags
checks: doc_title bookmark on the Title paragraph

rules.title: Headings, bookmarks and OMS tags
checks: every Heading 1/2 has a bookmark and is followed by a tag line
tag line holds ODS.OMSTags@<that bookmark> (plain-text tag line = LITE, auto-fix)
every tag is one of the 54 expectations
no orphan or duplicate tag controls

rules.title: 'Shall' only in binding styles
checks: no 'shall' in non-binding paragraphs or table cells

rules.title: People match the organisation register
checks: each person is 'Name — Job title' exactly as in ACE_People.csv
known name with wrong title → auto-fix

rules.title: Control IDs
checks: C-SSS-NNN with a valid system code
every ODS.RiskControl paragraph carries a Control ID content control (legacy → warning)
plain-text IDs in RiskControl paragraphs → auto-fix

rules.title: Parent document
checks: parent exists in the document register

rules.title: Process (PRS) pair
checks: JSON file present with same number and revision
every step has a bookmarked narrative heading

rules.title: Implementing processes table (STD, PRA)
checks: table listing implementing processes and procedures present

rules.title: No lock or temporary files
checks: no ~$ or .tmp files in the submission
